args.content:
LANDSCAPE SYSTEMS (10 visible):
- workday.hcm: HCM - compensation agents only, NO REST API for staffing data
- sap.sf: SuccessFactors HCM - REST API: EmployeeCompensationManagement:v1. KEY AGENTS:
  * SkillsAndCapabilityMatchingOrchestrator:v1 - workforce skills analysis & training recommendations
  * PerformanceReviewCycleCoordinator:v1
  * CompensationPolicyAutomationEngine:v1
- sap.s4: ERP - MaterialReceiptInboundAPI, Procurement agents, OpportunityToOrderAutomationEngine
- sap.crm: CRM - CAMPAIGN ENGAGEMENT TRACKING & MANAGEMENT:
  * CampaignAudienceOptimizationCoordinator:v1 - ORCHESTRATES campaign execution & coordinates across customer accounts & segments
  * CampaignAudienceOptimizationAgent:v1 - analyzes customer segments & real-time engagement metrics
  * OpportunityQualificationAdvisor, SalesProductChangeCoordinator, SalesCompensationOrchestrator
- sap.ehs: Safety/health - KEY AGENTS FOR SAFETY ANALYSIS:
  * IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer:v1 - ANALYZES SAFETY INCIDENTS & TRENDS
  * IncidentResponseCoordinator:v1
  * SafetyComplianceAutomationCoordinator:v1
- sap.ariba: Procurement - KEY AGENTS:
  * VendorInvoiceReconciliationAutomation:v1 - 3-way matching
  * SupplierComplianceAndIncidentMonitor:v1 - HAZMAT tracking & SAFETY CERTIFICATIONS verification
  * MaterialAndEngineeringChangeCoordinator:v1
  * **PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI:v1 (REST) - exposes Vendor & PurchaseOrder entities**
- corp.itsm: IT service mgmt - agents ONLY (for IT tickets, NOT manufacturing maintenance):
  * IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer:v1 (IT-focused)
  * AssetProvisioningOrchestrator:v1
  * ChangeAutomationOrchestrator:v1
- emarsys.cx: CX/marketing - agents ONLY
- my.mes: Manufacturing - KEY AGENTS/APIs:
  * EquipmentOEEAnalytics (REST API) - machine performance metrics only
  * ProductionQualityMonitor - quality inspection monitoring
  * ProductionChangeOrchestrator:v1
  * BillOfMaterialsComplianceValidator:v1
  * **NO maintenance request/work order submission capability**
- siemens.plm: PLM - KEY AGENTS:
  * SupplierQualificationAndMaterialCoordinator:v1 - supplier qualification & material approval (NOT ongoing safety verification)
  * BOMComplianceValidator:v1
  * EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning:v1
- sap.odm: Data model (entity taxonomy only)

KEY FINDINGS:
- Equipment upgrade logging & tracking (audit-ready) → my.mes:agent:ProductionChangeOrchestrator:v1
- Safety incident analysis → sap.ehs:agent:IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer:v1
- Supplier qualification & regulatory compliance → siemens.plm:agent:SupplierQualificationAndMaterialCoordinator:v1
- Invoice reconciliation (3-way matching) → sap.ariba:agent:VendorInvoiceReconciliationAutomation:v1
- Pull vendor specifications & details → sap.ariba:apiResource:PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI:v1 (REST API)
- **SUPPLIER SAFETY CERTIFICATION & COMPLIANCE VERIFICATION → sap.ariba:agent:SupplierComplianceAndIncidentMonitor:v1** (hazmat certs, regulatory verification, non-compliance signals)

GAPS:
- **NO maintenance request submission capability** - landscape has production monitoring (OEE, quality) but no maintenance/work order management system
